cues.en: I'm used to thinking of the TED audience as a wonderful collection of some of the most effective, intelligent, intellectual,
cues.zh: 我习惯把 TED 观众看作一群绝佳的人，他们汇集了世界上一些最高效、最聪明、最有才智、

cues.en: savvy, worldly and innovative people in the world. And I think that's true. However, I also have reason to believe that many, if not most of you, are actually tying your shoes incorrectly.
cues.zh: 最精明、最见多识广、最有创新精神的人。我认为确实如此。不过，我也有理由相信，你们中的许多人——如果不是大多数人——其实都系错了鞋带。

cues.en: Now,
cues.zh: 现在，

cues.en: know that seems ludicrous.
cues.zh: 知道这听起来很荒唐。

cues.en: I know that seems ludicrous. And believe me, I lived the same sad life until about three years ago.
cues.zh: 我知道这听起来很荒唐。相信我，直到大约三年前，我一直过着同样可悲的生活。

cues.en: And what happened to me was I bought what was for me a very expensive pair of shoes, but those shoes came with round nylon laces, and I couldn't keep them tied. So I went back to the store and said to the owner, I love the shoes, but I hate the laces. He took a look and said, oh, you're tying them wrong.
cues.zh: 我遇到的事是，我买了一双对我来说非常贵的鞋，但那双鞋配的是圆形尼龙鞋带，我怎么都系不紧。于是我回到店里，对店主说：我喜欢这鞋，但我讨厌这鞋带。他看了一眼说：哦，你系错了。

cues.en: Now, up until that moment, I would have thought that by age 50,
cues.zh: 在那之前，我一直以为，到了50岁，

cues.en: one of the life skills that I had really nailed was tying my shoes.
cues.zh: 我真正掌握的其中一项生活技能，就是系鞋带。

cues.en: But not so. Let me demonstrate.
cues.zh: 但事实并非如此。让我演示一下。

cues.en: This is the way
cues.zh: 这就是

cues.en: that most of us were taught to tie our shoes.
cues.zh: 我们大多数人被教过的系鞋带方式。

cues.en: Now as it turns out... Thank you. Oh,
cues.zh: 现在事实证明……谢谢。哦，

cues.en: wait.
cues.zh: 等等。

cues.en: There's more. As it turns out,
cues.zh: 还有更多。事实证明，

cues.en: there's a strong form and a weak form of this knot. And we were taught to tie the weak form, and here's how to tell. If you pull the strands at the base of the knot,
cues.zh: 这个结有强形式和弱形式。我们学的是弱形式，辨别方法如下。如果你拉结底部的绳股，

cues.en: you can see that the bow will orient itself down the long axis of the shoe. That's the weak form of the knot. But not to worry.
cues.zh: 你会看到蝴蝶结会沿着鞋子的长轴方向摆放。这就是结的弱形式。不过别担心。

cues.en: If we start over
cues.zh: 如果我们重新来一遍

cues.en: and
cues.zh: 然后

cues.en: simply go the other direction around the bow,
cues.zh: 只要绕着这个环反方向走，

cues.en: we get this, the strong form of the knot. And if you pull the cords under the knot, you will see that the bow orients itself along the transverse axis of the shoe.
cues.zh: 就得到这个，结的牢固版。如果你拉一拉结下面的鞋带，会看到蝴蝶结会沿着鞋子的横轴方向对齐。

cues.en: This is a stronger knot. It will come untied less often. It will let you down less. And not only that, it looks better.
cues.zh: 这是个更牢的结。它更不容易松开，也更少掉链子。而且，它还更好看。

cues.en: We're gonna do this one more time.
cues.zh: 我们再来一遍。

cues.en: Start as usual.
cues.zh: 像平常一样开始。

cues.en: Go the other way around the loop. This is a little hard for children, but I think you can handle it.
cues.zh: 反方向绕这个圈。这对孩子来说有点难，但我觉得你能搞定。

cues.en: Pull the knot.
cues.zh: 拉紧这个结。

cues.en: There it is, the strong form of the shoe knot.
cues.zh: 看，这就是鞋带结的牢固系法。

cues.en: Now, in
cues.zh: 现在，在

cues.en: keeping with today's theme,
cues.zh: 与今天的主题保持一致的前提下，

cues.en: I'd like to point out, and something you already know, that sometimes a small advantage someplace in life can yield tremendous
cues.zh: 我想指出一点，也是你们已经知道的：有时候，生活中某个地方的一点小优势，能带来巨大的

cues.en: results someplace else.
cues.zh: 成果，在别的地方。

cues.en: Live long and prosper.
cues.zh: 生生不息，繁荣昌盛。
